sections.title: Official AFPD directories
descriptions: These department directories list personnel and their assigned 5J call signs. The dates below are the printed dates shown in the files.

Call sign assignments can change, and printed directory dates do not establish exact assignment effective dates. To verify officer identities, I cross-check names spoken on AFPD car-to-car recordings with the transmitting radio IDs, spoken 5J call signs, and these official directories. Associations are evaluated in the context of the recording dates.
